name: Digital Transformation Foundations
description: Comprehensive methodology for organizational digital transformation covering strategy, technology, organizational change, responsible governance, and lifecycle coordination. Derived from MBA Digital Transformation coursework (BEMM257, University of Exeter).

narratives.name: Digital Transformation Foundations Journey
narratives.description: Method-level narrative describing the Digital Transformation Foundations transformation lifecycle.

narrativeContexts.context: Organizations recognize digital disruption forces, assess current maturity, and formulate transformation vision spanning strategy, technology, people, and governance dimensions.

Strategic intent translates into actionable roadmaps: technology architecture blueprints, capability development plans, data strategies, and ethical governance frameworks align to deliver on the transformation vision.

Cross-functional teams build foundational capabilities: modern infrastructure, data pipelines, organizational redesign, innovation processes, and responsible AI practices emerge through collaborative co-creation.
Transformation delivers measurable outcomes: adaptive strategies, scalable platforms, agile organizations, embedded digital culture, and proactive governance create sustainable competitive advantage.
Continuous learning loops drive evolution: strategy adapts, technology composes, culture innovates, and governance anticipates — the organization becomes a perpetual transformation engine.
